name: Red Kidney Bean Pumpkin Curry
ingredients: 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp garam masala and ½ tsp chilli powder
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add ginger and garlic.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the pumpkin and 1 cup water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the kidney beans and simmer for 8 minutes, mashing a few pumpkin pieces to thicken.
note: Pumpkin adds natural sweetness that balances the earthy beans.
